lead: A modal dialog. Focus trapping, closing on Esc and the background scroll lock come from Base UI's Dialog.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.body: Width step {size}; the actual width comes from the theme style.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.body: The state is held outside the dialog.

no-close-button.title: Without Close Button
no-close-button.body: Close it with the button below or with Esc.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle these in `dialog.css`. The dialog renders in a portal, so `data-skein-theme` must be on `<html>` or `<body>`, not on a local container.
styling.viewport: Fixed-position scroll container that centres the dialog
styling.dialog: The dialog itself; `data-size` sets its max width
styling.close: Close button in the top right
